name: Operation: Death to Angerforge
label: Quest
description: Operation: Death to Angerforge: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You have done an exemplary job, friend. It is now time to send you on your last mission.
General Angerforge, the Dark Iron responsible for coordinating the attacks on the 109th division of the K.E.F. And the mass slaughter of our forces must be brought to justice.
This will undoubtedly be your most grueling mission, but should you succeed, you will be richly rewarded.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Has the Butcher of Blackrock been disposed of?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Finally! The villain been brought to justice! You are a remarkable individual, friend. Wear this medallion as a symbol of your stalwart dedication to the Horde and the K.E.F.
